fluff.overview: Clan doctrine generally treats conventional infantry as a necessary evil, though Clans like Hell's Horses have demonstrated that properly supported infantry can be an effective component of combined-arms operations. Mechanized Hover Points ride hovercraft that provide the fastest ground speed of any infantry transport, with the added capability of crossing water obstacles. This speed comes at the cost of durability, as hovercraft are fragile compared to tracked or wheeled vehicles, but in open terrain or coastal environments, few formations can match their ability to reposition quickly. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these Points field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require warriors to carry additional power packs.
